system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy

A Weapon with a Double Trigger treats one trigger as a "Safety," with the second trigger being a hair trigger that fires when the slightest pressure is applied to it. Weapons of this type can be extremely accurate, since only a small amount of pressure is needed to fire them (reducing the chance of moving the Weapon slightly while pulling the trigger), but this takes time and training.

If a character has the Careful Shot feat, they gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls if they Aim with a Weapon that has the Double Trigger Weapon Upgrade (rather than the normal +1 bonus provided by the feat).
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
